title: Expeditionary Ground Reconnaissance (EGR) Officer (I) (LtCol to 2ndLt) NMOS (0202, 0302), DC PP&O
raw_text:
4. MOS 0307, Expeditionary Ground Reconnaissance (EGR) Officer (I) (LtCol to
2ndLt) NMOS (0202, 0302), DC PP&O

    a. Summary. EGR Officers are the commanders or their assistants in the
reconnaissance battalions and force reconnaissance companies. As such, EGR
Officers plan, direct, and assist in the deployment and tactical employment
of Reconnaissance units. To fulfill these responsibilities, they evaluate
intelligence; estimate the operational situation; and formulate, coordinate
and execute appropriate plans for multi-domain reconnaissance, raids, fire
support, special insertion and extraction, communications, other special
reconnaissance missions, and operational logistics and maintenance. EGR
Officers are also responsible for the discipline, morale and welfare of their
units' Marines. This MOS may be assigned only as an NMOS.




                                          1-21                         Enclosure (1)
 1106                                                                NAVMC 1200.1L



       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Must be a U.S. citizen.

            (2) Security clearance:   SCI security clearance eligibility.

            (3) Must complete MOS requirements to be an Infantry Officer.

            (4) Must be a graduate of the Basic Reconnaissance Course (M10AHK2).

        (5) Must meet MOS classification standards, as listed in the glossary
(pg. xiv) prior to graduating from the Basic School.

        (6) Must be medically qualified to perform jump and combatant dive
qualifications in accordance with inter-service requirements established in
reference (ai) P117 Navy Manual of Medicine (NAVMED) and reference (at) Army
Regulation 40-501 (Standards of Medical Fitness).

       c.   Requirements

        (1) An officer will be awarded MOS 0307 as an NMOS by CMC (MMOA) upon
completion of the Basic Reconnaissance Course.

        (2) Company grade officers assigned to the Reconnaissance Battalion
shall complete the Basic Reconnaissance Course at the School of Infantry
(West) enroute (TEMINS) to their respective battalions unless it is waived
due to operational requirements by their receiving division.

        (3) Waivers to any prerequisites or requirements must be submitted to
and approved by the reconnaissance occupational field manager, HQMC (POF).

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (ca), Reconnaissance Training and Readiness Manual.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Special Forces Officer 55-1017.

       f.   Related Military Skill

            (1) Parachutist Officer, 8023.

            (2) Combatant Diver Officer, 8024.

            (3) Parachutist/Combatant Diver Officer, 8026.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
